note: Pinned corpora in canonical system-header mode with the embedded models. Recaptured after rebasing onto local master bb64b1e on Windows 11 x64 with MSYS2 MinGW GCC 15.2.0. Header-dependent totals use that toolchain as the reference. Counts include the 2026-11-20 vector specialization audit. The 2026-11-20 binder Host/interface-overload change recaptured the canonical IPC centers: Camera 808 -> 702 and ability_runtime 1762 -> 1641; ability_runtime edges_total 418036 -> 417915 and diagnostics 11944 -> 11945; HDF and HiView IPC counts are unchanged. The 2026-11-23 AAFwk TaskHandlerWrap::SubmitTask/SubmitTaskJust invoke models recaptured ability_runtime edges_total 417915 -> 418405, edges_indirect 2043 -> 2533 and public_edges_total 409148 -> 410574, with the same run reporting diagnostics 11944; the new probe pins AmsMgrScheduler::StartSpecifiedAbility reaching AppMgrServiceInner::StartSpecifiedAbility through its submitted lambda. The 2026-11-23 binder-wrapper member-resolution change recaptured ability_runtime functions_total 89063 -> 88690, functions_external 20414 -> 20041, edges_total 418405 -> 420602, edges_direct 255993 -> 257078, edges_external 158238 -> 159350, arg_flow_edges 455892 -> 457968, public_functions_total 85660 -> 85287 and public_edges_total 410574 -> 412771; diagnostics, IPC and indirect centers are unchanged. `budget_pops` is null so canonical runs use the analyzer's derived pop budget, which scales with the PAG constraint count and reaches a fixpoint instead of truncating at a flat cap (docs/POINTERS.md, Work budget). The range-for container read recaptured the modeled element counts (HDF 3 -> 4, HiView 33 -> 35, Camera 7 -> 8, Ability Runtime 38 -> 39) and ability_runtime edges_total 420602 -> 420605, edges_indirect 2533 -> 2536 and arg_flow_edges 457968 -> 457970, where ConnectServerManager's range-for callback dispatch now reaches its registered callbacks. The range-for pointee-const change recaptured ability_runtime edges_total 420605 -> 420591 and edges_direct 257078 -> 257064: const receivers no longer reach the non-const overload of ExtractInsightIntentGenericInfo::get(). See docs/EVAL_REPORT.md. The bind update moves callback edges to invocation sites. See docs/EVAL_REPORT.md, Deferred std::bind callables.

probes.name: Timer dispatch forwards the binding receiver and event to Plugin::OnEventProxy
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arg_flow_edges a JOIN call_sites s ON s.id=a.call_site_id JOIN functions c ON c.id=s.caller_fn_id JOIN variables actual ON actual.id=a.actual_var_id JOIN functions owner ON owner.id=actual.fn_id JOIN variables formal ON formal.id=a.formal_var_id JOIN functions t ON t.id=formal.fn_id WHERE c.name='OHOS::HiviewDFX::EventLoop::ProcessEvent' AND s.callee_text='event.task' AND t.name='OHOS::HiviewDFX::Plugin::OnEventProxy' AND owner.name='OHOS::HiviewDFX::Plugin::DelayProcessEvent' AND (formal.name,actual.name) IN (('this','this'),('event','event'))

probes.name: DecodedEvent forwards param to every local lambda
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.formal_var_id) FROM arg_flow_edges a JOIN call_sites s ON s.id = a.call_site_id JOIN files p ON p.id = s.file_id JOIN functions c ON c.id = s.caller_fn_id JOIN variables u ON u.id = a.actual_var_id JOIN variables v ON v.id = a.formal_var_id JOIN functions t ON t.id = v.fn_id WHERE p.path LIKE '%decoded_event.cpp' AND s.line IN (162, 201) AND c.name LIKE '%::DecodedEvent::AppendCustomized%Param' AND a.arg_index = 0 AND u.fn_id = c.id AND u.name = 'param' AND v.name = 'param' AND t.name GLOB c.name || '::$lambda*'
